title: A bare fine-structure constant near 137.0045 and a 4m+1 dimension rule

statements.text: From the 9D volume anchor, the bare fine-structure constant projects as $\alpha_0^{-1} = 4248 / \pi^3 \approx 137.0045$, and only dimensions $d = 4m + 1$ (5, 9, 13 and so on) can host rational holographic projections of the one-dimensional spectral flow. The gap to the measured 137.036 is read as vacuum polarization.

sources.quote: Only specific integer dimensions (5{D}, 9{D}, 13{D}\\dots) function as resonant geometric cavities
